================================================================================
Annotations between the type and the ellipsis
================================================================================

void m1(String @N ... xs) {
}

void m2(@N Object @N ... a) {
}

void m5(int @N ... ns) {
}

void m6(String @A @B ... xs) {
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (method_declaration
    (void_type)
    (identifier)
    (formal_parameters
      (spread_parameter
        (type_identifier)
        (marker_annotation
          (identifier))
        (variable_declarator
          (identifier))))
    (block))
  (method_declaration
    (void_type)
    (identifier)
    (formal_parameters
      (spread_parameter
        (modifiers
          (marker_annotation
            (identifier)))
        (type_identifier)
        (marker_annotation
          (identifier))
        (variable_declarator
          (identifier))))
    (block))
  (method_declaration
    (void_type)
    (identifier)
    (formal_parameters
      (spread_parameter
        (integral_type)
        (marker_annotation
          (identifier))
        (variable_declarator
          (identifier))))
    (block))
  (method_declaration
    (void_type)
    (identifier)
    (formal_parameters
      (spread_parameter
        (type_identifier)
        (marker_annotation
          (identifier))
        (marker_annotation
          (identifier))
        (variable_declarator
          (identifier))))
    (block)))

================================================================================
Scoped and argument annotations before the ellipsis
================================================================================

void m3(String @Valid ... v) {
}

void m4(String @lib.Valid ... w) {
}

void m4b(String @V2("x") ... v) {
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (method_declaration
    (void_type)
    (identifier)
    (formal_parameters
      (spread_parameter
        (type_identifier)
        (marker_annotation
          (identifier))
        (variable_declarator
          (identifier))))
    (block))
  (method_declaration
    (void_type)
    (identifier)
    (formal_parameters
      (spread_parameter
        (type_identifier)
        (marker_annotation
          (scoped_identifier
            (identifier)
            (identifier)))
        (variable_declarator
          (identifier))))
    (block))
  (method_declaration
    (void_type)
    (identifier)
    (formal_parameters
      (spread_parameter
        (type_identifier)
        (annotation
          (identifier)
          (annotation_argument_list
            (string_literal
              (string_fragment))))
        (variable_declarator
          (identifier))))
    (block)))

================================================================================
Annotations before the ellipsis in constructors and records
================================================================================

class C {
  C(String @N ... xs) {
  }
}

record R(String @N ... xs) {
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (class_declaration
    (identifier)
    (class_body
      (constructor_declaration
        (identifier)
        (formal_parameters
          (spread_parameter
            (type_identifier)
            (marker_annotation
              (identifier))
            (variable_declarator
              (identifier))))
        (constructor_body))))
  (record_declaration
    (identifier)
    (formal_parameters
      (spread_parameter
        (type_identifier)
        (marker_annotation
          (identifier))
        (variable_declarator
          (identifier))))
    (class_body)))

================================================================================
Varargs controls without pre-ellipsis annotations
================================================================================

void plain(String ... xs) {
}

void dims(String @N [] f) {
}

<T extends @N Object> T id(T x) {
  return x;
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (method_declaration
    (void_type)
    (identifier)
    (formal_parameters
      (spread_parameter
        (type_identifier)
        (variable_declarator
          (identifier))))
    (block))
  (method_declaration
    (void_type)
    (identifier)
    (formal_parameters
      (formal_parameter
        (array_type
          (type_identifier)
          (dimensions
            (marker_annotation
              (identifier))))
        (identifier)))
    (block))
  (method_declaration
    (type_parameters
      (type_parameter
        (type_identifier)
        (type_bound
          (annotated_type
            (marker_annotation
              (identifier))
            (type_identifier)))))
    (type_identifier)
    (identifier)
    (formal_parameters
      (formal_parameter
        (type_identifier)
        (identifier)))
    (block
      (return_statement
        (identifier)))))
